 Owned and Operated By: Cojak Investments of Orange Beach, LLC
 This Another Broken Egg Cafe location is owned and operated by Jake Alleman of Cojak Investments Group. Jake owns and operates 8 other Another Broken Egg Cafe locations across the South. 
Opening an Another Broken Egg Cafe restaurant in Orange Beach wasn’t a hard decision for Jake. After seeing a menu loaded with fresh ingredients and creative recipes across a wide variety of breakfast classics, memorable brunch dishes and lunchtime favorites, he was sold.
Jake also liked how the location was designed to feel like a casual getaway, served up with a generous side of family, friends and friendly service. Realizing that Orange Beach’s options for this kind of upscale, Southern-inspired menu with adult beverages were limited, he knew this Another Broken Egg restaurant would be an instant hit.
Jake opened his restaurant at 25910 Canal Road Suite K. Since then, this location has become a big part of the community by getting involved with area charities as well as a favorite breakfast and brunch spot for locals.
